interpretation: All four successes were verified alarm mutations; the same three alarm variants were solved across the two repeats, with one additional incorrect broad alarm update in repeat 1.
All six playlist-duration episodes remained unsuccessful, primarily from model timeouts or failure to use public show_song duration data.
Aggregate AC3 was not satisfied and must remain an explicit limitation; no claim of consistent overall task solving is justified.
decision: Select this runtime for the next general spec because it gives the best clean S2/S3 results and every criterion is at least valid. The spec must require honest documentation of AC3 and remaining zero-success task families, not redefine project acceptance.
